items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: But later on we had Manny’s... I was invited a couple of times... Manny would have all the instruments... I beat him [Manny] by one stroke.

ctx.x: I never seen the guitar player, Green, Freddie Green. But I became — in the place I didn’t see him, maybe he was playing there but I didn’t notice it. But later on we had Manny’s, it’s a music — it’s still there I think Manny. He’s dead but his son runs it. And they used to have a golf game every year and they’d invite all the big musicians who either deal with the store or hang out there, I don’t know. Well I was invited a couple of times. And the one time I was playing and Freddie Green was there too. He didn’t…
